summary:
Our project, Space Mission Design Game, is an interactive educational game designed to 
introduce users to the process of planning and designing a space mission. 
The main idea behind our project is to make space exploration and spacecraft design easier to 
understand through an interactive experience. Instead of only reading about space missions, 
users can take part in a simplified simulation where they make decisions and see how different 
choices affect their mission. 
We chose this idea because planning a space mission involves several important factors, 
including the destination, spacecraft equipment, mission requirements, and available budget. 
We wanted to turn these concepts into an engaging experience that allows users to understand 
the challenges involved in making these decisions. 
The game starts by allowing the player to select a destination. After that, the player begins 
designing a spacecraft by choosing suitable equipment while working within a limited budget. 
The player must balance the cost and quality of the selected equipment and consider whether it 
is appropriate for the chosen destination.
details: Development Process & Project Details 1. Team Planning and Brainstorming The project started with a team brainstorming session where all members shared ideas and discussed possible ways to address the challenge. We explored different approaches and focused on creating something interactive that could make space mission planning easier to understand. After discussing our options, we agreed on developing an educational game that simulates some of the decisions involved in designing a space mission. We chose this approach because we believed that an interactive simulation would be more engaging than presenting information through text alone. All team members participated in the planning, design, and development stages. Although we shared responsibilities throughout the process, our work was collaborative, and important decisions were discussed and made together. 2. Game Design and Structure Once we agreed on the main idea, we worked on organizing the game into clear stages to create a simple and understandable user experience. The game consists of three main stages: Stage 1: Destination Selection The player begins by choosing the destination of the space mission. This choice represents the starting point for the rest of the design process. Stage 2: Spacecraft Design The player moves to the spacecraft design stage, where different equipment options are available. Each choice has an associated cost and contributes to the overall spacecraft design. Stage 3: Budget and Equipment Optimization The player must make decisions while staying within a limited budget. The challenge is to balance equipment quality, cost, and suitability for the selected destination. This structure allows players to understand that designing a space mission requires more than selecting expensive equipment. Every decision should serve the mission’s objectives. 3. Development and Implementation We used Google AI Studio as a development assistant during the creation of the game. It helped us develop the initial concept, organize the game flow, suggest the design, and generate the code used in the implementation. Our team worked together throughout the development process, discussing the structure and the intended experience. We used our Computer Engineering background to contribute to the technical and logical aspects of the project. 4. Final Deliverables As part of the project, we prepared three main deliverables: * An interactive Space Mission Design Game. * A presentation created using Canva AI to help organize and present the project. * A demonstration video produced by our team to showcase the project. Together, these deliverables explain the idea, demonstrate the experience, and present the work completed by our team.
